keyword.en: electric 30 concrete pump 60 m 180 m which is vertical
keyword.zh: 电动30的60米和180米哪个是垂直

title.en: How to Read the Electric 30 Distance Pair
title.zh: 电动30的距离数对怎样读

description.en: Electric 30's fine-stone cell is labelled horizontal then vertical and prints 60 m / 180 m. The second number is vertical.
description.zh: 电动30的细石格标题是先水平后垂直，印出 60 m / 180 m。第二个数是垂直。

h1.en: How to Read the Electric 30 Distance Pair
h1.zh: 电动30的距离数对怎样读

directAnswer.en: On the Electric 30 concrete pump, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai labels the fine-stone line as horizontal / vertical and prints 60 m / 180 m. Horizontal is 60 m. Vertical is 180 m. The second number is larger, and the label still sets the order. A second row, aggregate-13, prints 20 m / 60 m under the same horizontal-then-vertical heading. Do not swap the pair so that it looks like Electric 20's 120 m / 40 m.
directAnswer.zh: 在电动30混凝土泵上，河北品锦机械在邢台把细石行标成水平/垂直，并印出 60 m / 180 m。水平是 60 m。垂直是 180 m。第二个数更大，标题仍然决定顺序。第二行 13 骨料在同样的“先水平后垂直”标题下印 20 m / 60 m。不要为了看起来像电动20的 120 m / 40 m 而把数对对调。

body.en: The heading is 细石输送（水平/垂直）. The value is 60 m / 180 m. Read left to right. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not print a note telling you to reverse the pair when the vertical figure is larger.
body.zh: 标题是细石输送（水平/垂直）。数值是 60 m / 180 m。从左到右读。河北品锦机械没有印注记说垂直数字更大时要颠倒数对。

body.en: Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) is 20 m / 60 m. That is not the fine-stone row. Maximum aggregate size on the same page is ≤ 3 cm. The 60 m in the second row is horizontal, while the 60 m in the first row is also horizontal. They are not one cell.
body.zh: 13骨料输送（水平/垂直）是 20 m / 60 m。那不是细石行。同一页的最大骨料粒径是 ≤ 3 cm。第二行的 60 m 是水平，第一行的 60 m 也是水平。它们不是同一格。

body.en: Electric 30 also prints 30 kW and 12–15 m³/h. Those cells do not change the distance order. The machine is a concrete pump from Xingtai, not a reinterpretation of Electric 20.
body.zh: 电动30还印 30 kW 和 12–15 m³/h。这些格子不改变距离顺序。这台机器是邢台的混凝土泵，不是对电动20的重新解释。

answer.en: No. On the fine-stone label, 180 m is the vertical figure.
answer.zh: 不是。在细石标题下，180 m 是垂直数字。

question.en: Does Electric 30 print a 24 mm row?

answer.en: No. It prints two distance rows and a maximum aggregate of ≤ 3 cm.
answer.zh: 没有。它印两行距离，以及最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。

answer.en: No. Keep the printed order under the horizontal / vertical heading.
answer.zh: 不要。在水平/垂直标题下保持印出的顺序。
